**Direct answer:** Sagg Eco Village is in the Ganderbal district of the Kashmir Valley, Jammu & Kashmir. Its listed address is Watlar Wuder, Lar, Ganderbal. The question's premise holds up.

I ran these searches and page reads myself instead of using the skill's multi-agent setup. The setup needs shell commands to create folders, which you ruled out, and a single factual question doesn't need it. I used four of the eight allowed retrievals.

**Claims and sources**

- It is in Ganderbal, Jammu & Kashmir. The Global Ecovillage Network page and Kashmir Life both say this, but neither names a village.
  - https://ecovillage.org/map/community/sagg-eco-village/
  - https://kashmirlife.net/kashmirs-sagg-eco-village-wins-silver-at-responsible-tourism-awards-2025-405409/

- The address is Watlar Wuder, Lar, Ganderbal, postal code 191201. Ganderbal town is about 6 km away. This comes from search-result summaries of the listing pages. I did not open those pages.
  - https://in.linkedin.com/company/saggecovillage
  - https://www.tripadvisor.com/Hotel_Review-g32869462-d17693204-Reviews-SAGG_Eco_Village_Kashmir-Bagh_Mahanand_Ganderbal_District_Kashmir_Jammu_and_Kashmir.html

- Tripadvisor places it near Bagh Mahanand, and one directory uses Chanthan Gulabpora. So nearby locality names vary between sources.
  - https://www.tripadvisor.com/Hotel_Review-g32869462-d17693204-Reviews-SAGG_Eco_Village_Kashmir-Bagh_Mahanand_Ganderbal_District_Kashmir_Jammu_and_Kashmir.html
  - https://eldercare.nears.me/places/india/jammu-and-kashmir/chanthan-gulabpora-bagh-mahanand/home-nursing-services/sagg-eco-village-elder-care/

- The coordinates are roughly 34.27°N, 74.76°E. This is a search-summary figure from Tripadvisor and Prakati, not a page I opened.
  - https://prakati.com/d/sagg-eco-village/

- It sits in the Harmukh foothills, overlooking the Sindh and Nigeen valleys. This also comes from a search summary only.
  - https://casaclan.com/projects/sagg-eco-village-kashmir/

- Fayaz Ahmad Dar founded it, and it is billed as J&K's first regenerative eco-village enterprise.
  - https://kashmirlife.net/kashmirs-sagg-eco-village-wins-silver-at-responsible-tourism-awards-2025-405409/

**Caveats**
- Sources disagree on the founding year. The Global Ecovillage Network page gives 2012 in its structured fields and 2013 in its description. This does not affect the location.
  - https://ecovillage.org/map/community/sagg-eco-village/
- I did not find an official page that I opened and confirmed myself. Before travelling, check the exact pin with the operator's site, saggecovillage.earth, which I did not open.
